newDirectLicenses.embedded: MIT/BSD-3-Clause short bundled notices; actual resolved MQTT dependency closure reviewed, complete browser-bundle provenance/notice inventory not established
BSD alternative explicitly offered; additional MIT, Tom Wu permissive, BSD-labelled and public-domain origins; OpenSSL-derived attribution has unresolved version/terms evidence
No additional license/notice detected; JavaScript parser without WASM/native addon

newDirectNativeAndLifecycle: No new direct package declares preinstall/install/postinstall or ships Node addon/WASM/binding.gyp. Forge legacy SWF is not a Node native addon. Other build lifecycle declarations and transitive prerequisites are retained in the dependency report.

compiledFindings.finding: Only server.js diff is one added paragraph in kill_process description, documenting managed-command tree termination and negative node:local PID guidance. Static names, input schemas and annotation definitions show no edits; schemas.js is byte-identical. Actual SDK-generated tool metadata remains a harness gate.

Entrypoint bytes are identical. Normal argv --no-onboarding stays in stdio; remote activation requires argv[2] remote or the separately guarded device entry. Static imports still load remote/MQTT/Forge code. This is static reachability evidence, not an observed runtime network or credential-read test.

Compiled0.3.3 contains the published origin/path checks, three fixed Supabase origins, saved endpoint-pair binding and redirect:error guards. These protect the outbound upstream remote client, and do not qualify Access-owned OAuth. Shared staging/development device directory remains unchanged in scope.

Adds shell-specific reading for POSIX/PowerShell/cmd, wrapper and script-file inspection, and unbash on ordinary process-tool import path. start_process selects the actual shell before inspection; blocked/error verdicts refuse, unseen verdicts can proceed with a note. This is not complete command containment or a sandbox.

kill_process first asks terminalManager.forceTerminate for an owned start_process session, reports a failed tree termination, and only falls back to terminatePid for an unrelated PID. General process-tree engine logic is unchanged apart from its explanatory comment.

Shared getShellEnvironment repairs PATHEXT/ProgramData. New bootstrap helper can relaunch with preserved Node/script/argv and lifetime channel on Windows libuv before1.52; pre-set UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE and newer libuv affect that branch. Supported host Node/libuv and owned shutdown need real qualification.

All12 shipped search/ripgrep artifacts are byte-identical, including search-manager and ripgrep resolver/verifier. Shared shell resolver/environment changes and newly resolved dependencies can still affect behavior; unchanged search bytes are not a runtime equivalence proof.

The PDF delta prioritizes system Chromium over Puppeteer cache under MCP_CLIENT_DOCKER=true and adds --no-sandbox for that marker. Marker is an environment equality check, not a container verification. Existing stdio initialization still preemptively checks/downloads Chrome and preloads documents. Non-Docker browser cache/profile behavior still needs disposable-host proof.

installationPrerequisites: Install and compare the recorded exact control/candidate locks; corrected source lock is statically reconciled, installation behavior remains a hosted runtime gate.
Record actual ripgrep binary: resolver can fall back to system PATH/common installations; successful postinstall alone does not demonstrate availability.
Qualify Chromium/Puppeteer/native document support and cache ownership on disposable hosts; --no-onboarding does not suppress browser acquisition.
Qualify configured Windows shells/Node/libuv, command inspection and owned process-tree/EOF cleanup.
limitations: No npm install, upstream import/execution/build, production verifier, credential read or repository mutation was performed. All writes are owned scratch evidence.
SHA-512/SHA-1 verify archive bytes against registry metadata. Registry signatures/Sigstore chains and builder identity were not cryptographically verified.

Decoded publication/provenance subjects match archive SHA-512. SLSA resolved source commits are one version-only release commit before npm gitHead; exact comparisons are retained. This is not a reproduced source build.
Neither main tarball ships package-lock.json/npm-shrinkwrap.json or original TypeScript sources. Existing dependency ranges do not pin the actual installation closure.

All 31 added paths / 29 unique dependency artifacts were checked. The actual MQTT normal/optional dependency graph has no unresolved edges. Unchanged baseline dependency notices and complete bundled-browser component inventory were not re-audited; this is not whole-distribution license or redistribution clearance.

Desktop Commander UI bundles are byte-identical across versions; the package ships only its root LICENSE as a separately named license/notice file. No license/copyright text was detected in those UI bundles. Bundled third-party notice completeness was not established.

Twenty-four added artifacts provide registry gitHead: 23 pinned manifest/LICENSE pairs match shipped bytes, while MQTT differs only in manifest version. Five lack gitHead. Full source build equivalence was not reproduced; Forge legacy SWF lacks ActionScript source in its tarball.

Normal --no-onboarding stdio does not imply offline startup. The index initializes feature flags and background Chrome support; a postinstall script targets installation telemetry and ripgrep verification, with a fallback that masks nonzero exit status.
This inspection does not approve production rollout, claim a reachable Access OAuth vulnerability was repaired, establish runtime53-tool equivalence, or grant final legal/redistribution clearance.
compiledPatch: Full compiled delta is retained in the original read-only evidence directory; selected compiled hashes and findings are in this report.
evidenceDirectory: This commit-ready subset; raw tarballs/extracted distributions remain in separately retained scratch evidence.

resolvedFinding.description: Initial npm lock-only regeneration removed libc metadata from 16 unchanged Sharp/libvips entries; registry and control retained it. Owner restored only those fields. All16 records now exactly match control.
